documents.content:
# AL-MUKH Master Configuration
master_vault:
  path: "/home/kali/AL-MUKH"
  read_only_for_spokes: true

spoke_roots:
  - path: "/home/kali/Documents/Obsidian Vault"
    recursive: true

namespaces:
  reserved_prefixes:
    - "proj-"
    - "research-"
    - "personal-"
    - "archive-"
    - "template-"
    - "area-"
  validation:
    max_length: 64
    pattern: "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$"
    forbidden: ["system", "temp", "tmp", "cache", "logs", "spokes", "index", "refs", "search"]

watcher:
  recursive: true
  exclude_patterns:
    - ".obsidian/**"
    - ".git/**"
    - ".trash/**"
    - "*.tmp"
    - "*.swp"
    - "*.bak"
    - "*.orig"
    - "AL-MUKH/spokes/**"
    - "AL-MUKH/index/**"
    - "AL-MUKH/refs/**"
    - "AL-MUKH/search/**"
    - "AL-MUKH/logs/**"
    - "**/__pycache__/**"
    - "**/.DS_Store"
  debounce_ms: 100
  batch_size: 100
  follow_symlinks: false
  ignore_directories: false
  case_sensitive: true

indexer:
  meilisearch_url: "http://localhost:7700"
  index_name: "mukh-unified"
  batch_size: 50
  commit_interval_ms: 500
  arabic_analyzer: true
  local_queue_db: "AL-MUKH/indexer_queue.sqlite"
  snapshot_dir: "AL-MUKH/search/snapshots"
  snapshot_interval_hours: 24
  max_file_size_mb: 100
  content_extraction:
    markdown: true
    frontmatter: true
    headings: true
    code_blocks: true
    wiki_links: true
    tags: true
  doc_id_strategy: "content_hash_path"

syncer:
  symlink_method: "auto"
  conflict_strategy: "namespace_prefix"
  max_file_size_mb: 100
  health_port: 8765
  symlink_permissions: 0o755
  atomic_replace: true

dashboard:
  update_interval_sec: 300
  moc_depth: 3
  trends_window_days: 30
  max_recent_changes: 50

validation:
  schedule: "0 3 * * 0"
  check_broken_links: true
  check_duplicates: true
  check_orphaned_symlinks: true
  check_index_consistency: true
  report_dir: "AL-MUKH/refs"
  retention_days: 90

disk_monitor:
  warning_pct: 80
  pause_pct: 90
  check_interval_sec: 60
  alert_on_pause: true

logging:
  level: "INFO"
  format: "json"
  rotation: "10 MB"
  retention: "30 days"
  include_traceback: true
